Key Takeaways

  • The Pattadhar Passbook (PPB) is the official ownership document for agricultural land in Telangana.
  • It records the owner, survey numbers, extent and nature of the land, and is now issued electronically.
  • You need it for land sales, crop loans, government schemes and any agricultural land transaction.
  • Errors in name, extent or survey number in the PPB block sales and loans until corrected.
  • We handle issuance, corrections and reprints remotely through the land records system.

For agricultural land in Telangana, the Pattadhar Passbook is the single most important ownership document. Banks, buyers and government departments all rely on it to confirm who owns the land and how much.

JaaGa helps you obtain a new electronic PPB, correct errors in an existing one, or get a reprint — without repeated trips to the MRO or tahsildar office.

When You Need a PPB

Before selling agricultural land, applying for a crop loan, or enrolling in a government scheme like Rythu Bandhu.

When the passbook has an error in the owner name, extent or survey number, or when it has been lost and needs a reprint.

How We Handle Your PPB

  1. 1

    Verify Land Records

    We check the current land record, survey number and ownership status for your parcel.

  2. 2

    Prepare Application

    We prepare the PPB issuance or correction application with your ownership and identity documents.

  3. 3

    File & Coordinate

    We file with the tahsildar / land records office and coordinate the verification.

  4. 4

    Passbook Delivered

    You receive the electronic Pattadhar Passbook, or the corrected/reprinted copy.

Documents Required

  • Existing passbook or link document (if any)
  • Survey number and village details
  • Owner identity and address proof
  • Recent Adangal / Pahani extract

Common Problems We Solve

Name / extent mismatch

Records often carry spelling or extent errors that stall sales. We identify and file the correction.

Inheritance not updated

When land passed to heirs but the PPB wasn't updated, we handle the succession update.

Survey sub-division issues

Sub-divided survey numbers can be mis-recorded. We reconcile them with the records.

Why Pattadhar Passbook Matters

Without a correct Pattadhar Passbook, agricultural land is effectively frozen — you can't sell it, raise a loan against it, or claim scheme benefits. Getting the PPB right is the foundation of every agricultural land transaction in Telangana.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is a Pattadhar Passbook?

It is the official ownership document for agricultural land in Telangana, recording the owner, survey numbers, extent and nature of the land — now issued in electronic form.

How do I correct an error in my PPB?

A correction application is filed with the tahsildar/land records office with supporting documents. We prepare, file and follow it up for you.

Can I get a PPB if I inherited the land?

Yes — the passbook is updated to the heirs with legal-heir proof, which we help assemble.

Is the passbook the same as title?

It is strong evidence of ownership for agricultural land, but a full title check (deeds, EC, prohibited-land) is still recommended before buying.

Can this be done remotely?

Yes. Share your land and identity details on WhatsApp and we handle filing and follow-up.
